'''James Boyd''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 AugustaCon EPP Overdrive (Day 1)]] in October 2000 with DS War Room, according to Landon Sommer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1385">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loserd1385/ 2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loser], DeckTech (Landon "Periculum" Sommer, 25 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-25-2-in-1-augustacon-from-a-loserd1385/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
